description:
🪔❤️ Project Diwali Faral – Spreading Smiles ❤️🪔

Dear Rotarians & RCMMS Family,

Diwali becomes even more special when we share its joy with those who need it the most. Through Project Diwali Faral, we brought the warmth and sweetness of the festive season to 510 children of Shri Gadge Maharaj Ashramshala, Berwal, Trimbakeshwar, Nashik.

The initiative provided each child with a festive faral kit comprising chivda, shev, chakli, laddoo and shankarpali, ensuring that these children too can experience the joy of Diwali and feel included in the celebrations.

🗓 Occasion: Diwali 2026
📍 Venue: Shri Gadge Maharaj Ashramshala, Berwal, Trimbakeshwar, Nashik
👧👦 Beneficiaries: 500 children
🎁 Cost per kit: ₹87
💰 Total Project Cost: ₹45,000/-

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to all the Rotarians who have committed their support towards this initiative.

🪔 500 children. 500 smiles. One beautiful Diwali! ❤️

Regards,
Rtn. Amit Gupta – President
Rtn. Sonal Saxena – Secre
